item.title: January 17, Feast Day of Agios Antonios O Megas
item.description: January 17 is the Feast Day for Agios Antonios O Megas (Saint Anthony the Great), the revered Father of Monks, celebrated by the Greek Orthodox Church and other traditions as the day he departed this life around 356 AD at 105 years old, marking his life of radical asceticism, prayer, and founding Christian monasticism in the Egyptian desert. item.title: Greek Tourist Has Less than 5% Chance of Walking After Australian Beach Accident
item.description: Ioannis Vidiniotis, 28, from Athens, faces quadriplegia after hitting a sandbank at Perth's Cottesloe Beach on New Year's Eve. With less than 5% chance of ever walking again, the Greek community of WA launches major fundraiser. item.title: Court Gives Life Sentence to Woman Who Killed, Buried Partner
item.description: The Mixed Jury Court of Edessa sentenced a 35-year-old woman to life imprisonment for killing her 58-year-old partner and burying his body in the yard of their home in Leptokarya, Pieria. item.title: Rhodes: Body of a man found on Gennadi beach in area where 33 foreigners were located
item.description: A man's body was discovered on Gennadi beach in Rhodes this morning, following reports of foreigners in the area. Authorities located 33 migrants nearby (8 men, 12 women, 13 minors), and the body has been transferred for autopsy amid ongoing inquiries into possible links.
